Job Description 
 Who We Are 
 Horizon Media , founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. We are headquartered in New York City, with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto. A leader in driving business solutions for marketers, Horizon is known for its highly personal approach to client service.  Renowned for its incredible culture, Horizon is consistently named to all the prestigious annual Best Places to Work lists published by Fortune, AdAge, Crain’s New York Business and Los Angeles Business Journal. Together we are building a place of belonging. 
 
At Horizon, we understand the value that different perspectives can bring to our clients and culture, so we strive for an environment where our employees feel welcomed, safe and empowered. We value YOU and believe that your authentic voice and unique perspective allows us to create a more rewarding culture, and experience, together. 
  
Our simple recipe for success? We hire talented people (thinkers, doers, dreamers, makers), challenge them and give them every opportunity to grow. 
 
 Job Summary 
 As a Junior Frontend Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining modern React-based user interfaces while collaborating with senior engineers to build scalable web applications.
 
 Job Duties 
 (50%) Front-End Application Development 
 Develop and maintain modern front-end applications using React.js and TypeScript
 Build reusable, responsive user interface components using HTML5 and CSS3
 Consume REST APIs using Axios or Fetch and display API data within the application
 Work with JSON data structures and integrate backend services into the UI
 Collaborate with senior engineers to implement new features and enhancements
 
 (25%) Application Integration & Collaboration 
 Implement front-end functionality using asynchronous programming patterns including Promises and async/await
 Debug application issues using browser developer tools
 Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior engineers
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment
 Learn and contribute to modern front-end development practices
 
 (25%) Engineering Excellence 
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
 Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, pull requests, and collaboration
 Follow established coding standards and engineering best practices
 Participate in testing, debugging, and issue resolution
 Continuously developing technical skills and contributing to team knowledge sharing
 
 Job Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
 1-3 Years professional experience developing front end applications.
 Strong understanding of React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3.
 Experience with Typescript
 Experience consuming REST API’s using Axios or Fetch
 Comfortable working with JSON data and API responses.
 Understanding of asynchronous programming, such as promises, async/await
 Familiarity with common data structures including Arrays, objects, maps, sets
 Experience with common Git commands such as push, pull, merge, fork, clone
 Basic debugging skills using browser developer tools.
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Next.js
 Experience with Tailwind
 Experience with Claude Code/Codex
 Understanding of micro frontend architecture
 Understanding of module federation
 Experience with AWS Amplify/ Cubernetes/Docker
 Experience working in an Agile environment
 Understanding of responsive design
 
 Technologies 
 Primary 
 React.js
 Typescript
 JavaScript ES6+
 HTML5
 CSS3
 REST APIs
 AWS/GCP
 Git
 
 Nice to Have 
 Next.js
 Tailwind
 Python
 Experience working with the business users or stakeholders to build and test UI components
 Experience with integrating Data lakes and platforms such as Databricks /Snowflake/ Redshift/BigQuery
 
 #LI-KG1
 #LI-HYBRID
 #HM
 
 
 Horizon Media is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. 
 
 Salary Range 
$80,000.00 - $110,000.00 
 
 A successful applicant’s actual base salary may vary based on factors such as individual’s skill sets, experience, training, education,  licensure/certifications, and qualifications for the role.  As an organization, we take an aptitude and competency-based hiring approach.   We provide a competitive total rewards package including a discretionary bonus and a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, company paid holidays and unlimited paid time off (PTO), mental health and wellness resources, pet insurance, childcare resources, identity theft insurance, fertility assistance programs, and fitness reimbursement.
